approval.user_decision_scope: Earlier individual Q1-Q6 constraints, where recorded, are design instructions; they do not approve labels or the final ontology.

MATERIAL.definition: A substance, composition, or material system considered as matter.
MATERIAL.examples: graphene; graphene oxide; reduced graphene oxide; Ti3C2Tx MXene
MATERIAL.boundary: A fabricated sensor or functional component is DEVICE; a material may FUNCTIONS_AS a device component without becoming identical to it.
MATERIAL.canonicalization: Preserve composition, oxidation, dopant and defect distinctions; expand locally defined aliases only.

DEVICE.definition: An engineered object or functional physical component with a technical role.
DEVICE.examples: gas sensor; electrode; sensing layer; membrane
DEVICE.boundary: A pore, junction or electronic layer described as structure is MORPHOLOGY; a manufactured electrode layer is DEVICE.
DEVICE.canonicalization: Separate device class from source-scoped configuration and experimental instance.

PROPERTY.definition: A physical, chemical, structural or manufacturing attribute or parameter of a bearer.
PROPERTY.examples: hole concentration; oxygen atomic ratio; adsorption energy; noise; pore width
PROPERTY.boundary: Sensitivity, selectivity, detection limit and task response are PERFORMANCE; a geometric structure is MORPHOLOGY.
PROPERTY.canonicalization: Keep parameter identity distinct from value, direction of change, condition and bearer instance.

PERFORMANCE.definition: A capability, task outcome or evaluation measure in an application.
PERFORMANCE.examples: sensitivity; selectivity; response; detection limit; sensing stability
PERFORMANCE.boundary: Physical conductivity, carrier concentration and noise are PROPERTY even when they explain performance.
PERFORMANCE.canonicalization: Do not identify measurements across different analytes, configurations or conditions; retain those attachments.

ANALYTE.definition: A substance or explicit substance class in the contextual role of target, adsorbate or comparison gas.
ANALYTE.examples: NH3 target; NO2 target; comparison gases/VOCs
ANALYTE.boundary: NO2 used as dopant in D060 is MATERIAL; do not turn a generic gas mention into a specific chemical.
ANALYTE.canonicalization: Role-specific mention kind does not assert a different chemical species; no SAME link between different compounds.

PROCESS.definition: A technical action, transformation, operation or event, including formation and measurement.
PROCESS.examples: microwave treatment; adsorption; junction formation; n-doping
PROCESS.boundary: MECHANISM describes how or why a phenomenon occurs; the event it involves remains PROCESS.
PROCESS.canonicalization: Keep the event of formation distinct from the resulting object and from a named method family.

MECHANISM.definition: A source-expressed explanation, interaction, or combined explanatory account of technical behavior.
MECHANISM.examples: electrostatic interaction; sensing mechanism; combined current and mobility effects
MECHANISM.boundary: A junction itself is MORPHOLOGY; formation is PROCESS; do not promote every process into an explanation.
MECHANISM.canonicalization: Preserve the scope of hypothesized accounts and joint explanations; no inferred quantitative cancellation.

OPERATING_CONDITION.definition: An environmental, sample or operating circumstance under which a claim applies.
OPERATING_CONDITION.examples: 150 °C; room temperature; gas mixture with reducing gases
OPERATING_CONDITION.boundary: A measured outcome is PROPERTY/PERFORMANCE. A laser setting can be PROPERTY of a process.
OPERATING_CONDITION.canonicalization: Normalize only explicit, unambiguous units and retain original values; room temperature is not silently 25 °C.

MORPHOLOGY.definition: A structural arrangement, shape, geometry or electronic/spatial feature.
MORPHOLOGY.examples: heterojunction; pore; electron accumulation/depletion layer; charged impurities
MORPHOLOGY.boundary: Material composition is MATERIAL; engineered sensing/electrode components are DEVICE; carrier concentration is PROPERTY.
MORPHOLOGY.canonicalization: Preserve junction composition, pore passivation, electronic layer type and location; never equate interfaces with their formation.

TECHNOLOGY.definition: A named technology or method family referenced as an approach.
TECHNOLOGY.boundary: A concrete execution or transformation is PROCESS; a technical end use is APPLICATION.
TECHNOLOGY.canonicalization: A source may name a method family and an execution separately; RELATED does not imply SAME.

APPLICATION.definition: An explicitly named end use, task or application field.
APPLICATION.examples: gas separation; breath analysis; gas sensing; disease diagnostics
APPLICATION.boundary: A device class such as fuel cell remains DEVICE; vague impact on it does not by itself establish USED_FOR.
APPLICATION.canonicalization: Preserve application scope and prospective modality; do not turn discussion of a field into a fabricated device.

OTHER.definition: A source-expressed technical referent that does not fit the other kinds.
OTHER.examples: clothes as receiving host; functional template role
OTHER.boundary: Use only after checking the specific kinds; contextual_role can mark a role or group without adding a new kind.
OTHER.canonicalization: Keep source-scoped identity; OTHER is not permission to relax relation domains.

HAS_PROPERTY.definition: The bearer has the stated non-task physical, chemical, structural or process attribute.

HAS_PROPERTY.contrast: Hole concentration belongs here; sensitivity belongs under HAS_PERFORMANCE. An increase in concentration also needs CHANGES_PARAMETER.
HAS_PROPERTY.nearest_relations: HAS_PERFORMANCE measures task outcomes; DEPENDS_ON relates a dependent quantity to its explanatory variable.
HAS_PROPERTY.ambiguity_policy: Abstain when the predicate, attachment, scope or endpoint referent is not licensed by the source. Preserve the weakest explicitly supported modality; no inferred transitive assertions.
HAS_PROPERTY.group_policy: Distribute only when grammar explicitly licenses each member claim. Otherwise use an exact-span group with HAS_MEMBER and scope=collective. Never infer Cartesian products.

qualifier_schema.unknown_types: reject in accepted assertions; record unresolved candidates
qualifier_schema.required_qualifier_rule_format: Mapping qualifier_type -> constraints, including enum on raw_value.

polarity.NEGATIVE: The relation is explicitly negated; negation scope remains local.
polarity.UNKNOWN: Uncertain polarity; candidate/abstention only, not SUPPORTED.

modality.ASSERTED: Author presents the statement as holding, including calculated results.
modality.PROPOSED: Author proposes or suggests a mechanism, explanation or design.
modality.COMPARED: A comparative assertion with its source-stated comparator.
modality.HYPOTHETICAL: Possibility, potential, goal or future capability, without demonstrated realization.

support_policy.accepted: SUPPORTED + DIRECT_SOURCE + AI_DRAFT; this means source support, not independently established physical truth.
support_policy.abstention: INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE decisions retain UNRESOLVED candidates and evidence; REJECT candidates remain in immutable decision records.

evidence_policy.offsets: Python Unicode codepoints [start,end), relative to frozen chunk text.
evidence_policy.required: At least one exact source evidence span for each accepted assertion; source text and SHA-256 must match.
evidence_policy.qualifier_grounding: Exact raw_text span and matching assertion attachment required.
evidence_policy.source_context: Record source_relation_type, source_modality, source_polarity, interpretation_basis=AI_DEV_SOURCE_REVIEW, and evidence_span_ids as an AI regression interpretation; not an independent semantic oracle.

cannot_merge: different device configurations absent explicit identity
canonicalization.same_policy: Only aliases or co-reference established by this source license SAME. RELATED/BROADER/NARROWER are not identity. Chemical class membership is not SAME.
canonicalization.unicode: Preserve source Unicode; chemical spacing normalization is conceptual only; original spans stay unchanged.

group_policy.joint_negation: NEGATIVE MEETS_REQUIREMENT with joint_requirement=all means NOT(all); no member-specific negation follows.
group_policy.mixed_requirements: PROPERTY requirement_bundle can contain PROPERTY/PERFORMANCE members; no new entity kind needed.

provenance.isolation: Semantic design used a fresh isolated agent context and only the enumerated DEV bundle. Parent session had earlier evaluation exposure; end-to-end historical independence cannot be proved.
provenance.historical_limitation: The first 0.3 freeze persistence failed, evaluation text was shown before retry. Historical artifacts are preserved and not retroactively claimed perfectly isolated.
provenance.ai_self_audit: Two separate logical passes by the same AI; not independent human review.

proposal_disposition.INCREASES: MAP_TO_EXISTING: CHANGES_PARAMETER + direction=increase; physical increase kept distinct from IMPROVES.
proposal_disposition.DECREASES: Covered by CHANGES_PARAMETER + direction=decrease, grounded in D078.
proposal_disposition.USED_FOR_DEVICE_RANGE: Not admitted: DEV impact wording is insufficient to establish device-directed use; D024-Q6/Q7 remain unresolved.
